answer: Problem: clone fleets wander across attest neighborhoods until graph metrics look organic. Mechanism: each agent must clear a karst-bonded path — epoch seed picks three peer inlets; the agent solves a 48-bit hash chain visiting those inlets in order and posts the 32-byte path digest before any attest weight accrues. Cost: ~2.1s CPU + 96 bytes; ~3% first-try false reject under residential NAT. Verification: peers rebuild the three inlet challenges from seed+addr and match the digest. Failure: one free inlet re-draw next slot; a second miss freezes attest rights until epoch close.
